payload.title: M6 — Verify visual quality and Babulus adoption
payload.description:
## Outcome
Demonstrate reliable visual results, useful authoring guidance, and compatibility in a real consuming product.

## Ownership
toolchain, videoml-org, player; Babulus integration

## Completion
All child behavior stories have implementation and verification evidence. Update the parent initiative body with decisions, coverage, and remaining work. This is planned work, not a claim that the features already ship.
